description: Streamlit web application for analytical method comparison in clinical microbiology and clinical chemistry. Supports Passing-Bablok regression, Deming regression, zone diameter confusion matrix, and EP15-A3 precision evaluation.

important_files.app.py: Single Streamlit entry point — 996 lines — all UI logic, sidebar, four analysis branches
important_files.analysis/deming.py: Ordinary and weighted Deming regression with jackknife CIs
important_files.analysis/statistics.py: Pearson r, R-squared, bias, Bland-Altman limits of agreement
important_files.analysis/confusion.py: Zone diameter count matrix, essential agreement, categorical agreement, VME, ME
important_files.analysis/precision.py: CLSI EP15-A3 within-run and within-laboratory precision evaluation
important_files.analysis/export.py: CSV export, HTML report builder, DPI label helpers
important_files.plots/regression_plot.py: Plotly interactive regression and Bland-Altman plots
important_files.plots/confusion_plot.py: Plotly interactive confusion matrix heatmap and matplotlib static export
important_files.plots/mpl_export.py: Matplotlib PNG and SVG export for regression and Bland-Altman plots
important_files.tests/test_regression.py: Unit tests for Passing-Bablok (8 tests — regression only)
important_files..github/workflows/keep_awake.yml: GitHub Actions workflow — pings app every 6 hours
important_files..github/scripts/wake_streamlit.py: Playwright script — clicks Streamlit wake button if app is sleeping

passing_bablok.returns: dict: slope, slope_lower, slope_upper, intercept, intercept_lower, intercept_upper, n, n_excluded
passing_bablok.algorithm: Rank-based median of pairwise slopes, Passing & Bablok 1983

confusion_matrix.function: analysis.confusion.build_count_matrix(x, y, step, x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max)
confusion_matrix.returns: (matrix ndarray, x_bins ndarray, y_bins ndarray) — always square symmetric
confusion_matrix.colour_encoding: Distance from identity diagonal, not count

precision_ep15a3.returns: dict: sr, sb, sl, cv_r, cv_l, df_within, df_between, T, verif_sr, verif_sl, pass_sr, pass_sl, day_summary, outliers

streamlit_session_state.reg_res: Regression result dict (set on Analyze click, regression branch only)
streamlit_session_state.stats: Summary statistics dict (set on Analyze click, regression branch only)
streamlit_session_state.x_raw: numpy array — reference method values (regression branch only)
streamlit_session_state.y_raw: numpy array — candidate method values (regression branch only)
streamlit_session_state.reg_method: String — method label for display (regression branch only)

decimal_convention: Comma as decimal separator (Swedish locale). fmt(v, d) returns f'{v:.{d}f}'.replace('.', ',')

image_export.engine: matplotlib (NOT kaleido — kaleido crashes on target Windows environment)

known_issues.description: Dead code: _read_excel() function defined at app.py lines 110-113, never called
Passing-Bablok O(n^2) pairwise slope computation — slow for n > 500
No automated tests for Deming, confusion matrix, or precision modules
Unused kaleido functions in export.py (_sanitize_fig, fig_to_png_bytes, etc.)

feature_status.github_actions_keep_awake: working — requires manual STREAMLIT_URL variable setup
